faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals?

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals is $95 Shared Mold (3 Finishes Included). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals?

faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include 1st Gold / 2nd Silver / 3rd Bronze. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals?

faqs.question: Does Custom Gold Silver Bronze Antique Award Medals meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.
